title: Eastman-trained players widen the band's palette
summary: Classically trained players like Vizzutti and Birch Johnson give the band leeway to attempt many approaches.

blocks.x: Yeah, okay. And Al Vizzutti, Pugh Birch (Johnson--ed.) Pezuti, among others, like Jim Pew and Urch and so forth, you've attracted people from Eastman School of Music, excellent classical training and can sit in any kind of chair, anywhere. And you've got those people in your band, or have had them in your band.

Yeah, well, I think the great thing about that is that it gives us such leeway and such openness, to attempt many different kinds of approaches. We're not limited to, like, what we can do just, like, laugh and swing. We can
That's why I said, like, the material in 'Road Father', you have 'Pavan' and you have all these other things. It's a very, very broad palette of colors.
